presentation.label: 128 arrangements per project
presentation.summary: 16 books of 8 arrangements per project: book A is stock's, books B to P live in the module's own files beside the project.
presentation.overview: Arr Setlists turns the Octatrack's 8 arrangements into 16 books of 8. Book A is stock's own and stays exactly as it is in arr01 to arr08; books B to P are files of the module's own in the project folder. In ARR > CHANGE, with the transport stopped, LEFT and RIGHT step through the books; inside a book every stock arrangement function works as usual. Setlists of up to 16 songs from any books follow in a later version.
highlights: 128 arrangements: 16 books of 8, book A untouched.
Switch books with LEFT/RIGHT in ARR > CHANGE, stopped.
Books are saved, saved as and reloaded with the project.
A project opens on book A, also on a unit without the module.
usage: Open ARR > CHANGE (MKII: ARR, then CHANGE; MKI: FUNC + PATTERN for arrangement mode, FUNC + BANK, then CHANGE), with the transport stopped.
Press RIGHT or LEFT to step to the next or previous book (A to P); the book's letter shows at the top right, and BOOK C confirms the switch.
Pick one of the book's 8 arrangements as usual and edit, save or chain it: stock's arrangement functions work inside the book.
Save the project as usual: every book is saved with it.
Before removing the module, step back to book A.

limitations: OS 1.40C. Not yet tested on a unit.
Books change only while the transport is stopped: the switch writes and reads the card, which stock itself does only stopped.

Switch back to book A before removing the module: without it, stock's next save writes the book in use into arr01 to arr08. Book A is kept in a backup file of the module's own and comes back the next time the module is installed and book A is chosen.
A project always opens on book A, after a power cycle too.
